'''Vespid''' was a classification of [[Insect/Legends|insect]]. The [[Yam'rii/Legends|Yam'rii]] were considered to almost fall within the vespid classification.<ref name="swarmwar" /> The [[Nevoota/Legends|Nevoota]] were vespids.<ref name="Skye">''[[SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story]]''</ref>
